[[:Category:Hardcore Maps|Hardcore]] |rewards = {{RewardsList|Normal}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Wrecked Battlefield''' is a [[Maps|map]] that appears to take place after a battle, where trenches have been set up and destroyed vehicles are plentiful. This map is included in the map rotation for [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, as well as the regular map rotation for normal gameplay. It is also the map used for the [[Speedy Enemies]] trial when active. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Current |'''Wrecked Battlefield''', as the name suggests, is a desecrated wasteland that harbors deteriorating plant life. Various destroyed vehicles and trees can be seen scattered across the map sides of the map. The middle of the map is full of trenches and cliffs. Multiple dead trees, sandbags and crates can also be seen there. The map is surrounded by elevated hills. The path begins at a portal and ends in a cave. The brown path moves across the trenches on the map and weaves around natural structures of the map. |Version 1 |'''Wrecked Battlefield''' appeared to take place in a gorge, surrounded by high rocky walls. Inside the gorge was a wasteland, with bare trees, debris, and objects that were rusted or broken (like walls, howitzers and vehicles) littered around the map. Various natural mounds and arches could also be seen. A river ran through the middle of the map in a canyon. The brown pebble path began at a portal and ended at a cave. It weaved around the natural structures of the map, as well as going over the river at a slightly inclined cobblestone bridge. }} ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Wrecked Battlefield}} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Normal}} ==Strategy== *There are many cliff spots on this map. For this reason, cliff towers are highly recommended on this map. **Be aware that the cliff spots are quite far from each other, so it is quite hard to boost a lot of cliff towers with [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]]. *You cannot place towers directly near the start of the map. Try to place them near the first or second corner. *The map has two distinct layers of ground: the one level with the path and the one slightly higher than the path. *There are many turns and corners on this map, try using this to your advantage. **Towers with somewhat short range such as the [[Gladiator]] or [[Warden]] may benefit from these corners. **The [[Ace Pilot]] is quite efficient in several spots of the map, especially in the large turns. **The area at the back of the map is especially effective for the [[Ace Pilot]], though it may take some time before enemies reach that part of the map. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} GI logo.png|Bugged iconOn the 7th of March 2022, '''Wrecked Battlefield''' was left as one of the few only survival maps. FirstPersonMinigunnerRender.png|Current version of '''Wrecked Battlefield''' on a render. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} 2023UpdateForecast.png|Current version of '''Wrecked Battlefield''' on an update forecast. }} ==Trivia== *'''Wrecked Battlefield''' is the oldest map in the game to be available for [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. **It is also the only Hardcore map in the game to be selectable in any Survival mode. *In the original version of this map, the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] would often get stuck at the end of the bridge near the exit due to a bug. If it performed ''Void Stomp'', it would become unstuck. **In addition, if the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] activated ''Void's Deathwish'', it would flip under the bridge and disappear into the ground. *It was possible for ground units, such as the ones from the [[Military Base]], to collide with flying enemies, like the [[Balloon]], when both were passing over the bridge of the original version of this map. *The original version of this map used the models of the Level 5 [[Ace Pilot]], the Level 5 [[Rocketeer]]'s howitzer, and the [[Humvee]] and [[Humvee|Truck]] from the [[Military Base]] as destroyed objects for decoration around the map. *Prior to the 12th of March 2022, this map was exclusive to [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. **It used to be the only [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode-exclusive map. *On 7th of March 2022, this alongside [[Grass Isle]], [[Crystal Cave]] and [[Sacred Mountains]] were accidentally left as the only survival maps in the game. It was unplayable as a survival map, as the game would never load the map. **'''Wrecked Battlefield''' was playable if you used a Hardcore [[Elevators|elevator]], though the old version of the map would be loaded. **On survival [[Elevators]], '''Wrecked Battlefield''' used the [[Grass Isle]] icon and difficulty. **This was later fixed on the same day. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Wrecked Battlefield''' added. **{{Bug}} Some enemies get stuck at the end of the bridge. *'''7 March 2022''' - [[v1.0.2]]c **{{Bug}} '''Wrecked Battlefield''' accidentally added as a survival map. ***This was fixed later the same day. *'''7 March 2022''' - [[v1.0.2]]d **{{Bugfix}} '''Wrecked Battlefield''' is no longer a survival map. *'''12 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]] **'''Wrecked Battlefield''' remade. **Difficulty changed from {{Color|Normal}} to {{Color|Hard}}. **'''Wrecked Battlefield''' is now playable as a survival map. *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **Difficulty changed from {{Color|Hard}} to {{Color|Normal}}. ==Notes== {{MapNavBox}} [[Category:Hardcore Maps]]
